_note: Academy page copy, keyed by programme id. DRAFT written from classes-seed.json summaries: confirm the level descriptions with each teacher before launch. Prices, sizes and times are never written here; they come from classes-seed.json.

kids-art-younger.headline: Weekly art classes for ages 5 to 9, taught by a working artist.
kids-art-younger.intro: Small groups of up to {cap}, one class a week, the same teacher every week. Children learn to draw what they see, mix their own colours and finish real pieces they are proud to bring home.

levels.name: Level 1 · Explore
levels.text: Line, shape and colour mixing; drawing from objects on the table; paint, pastel and clay.

levels.name: Level 2 · Build
levels.text: Observation drawing, simple composition and layering paint; a small series on one theme.

levels.name: Level 3 · Create
levels.text: Their own project from sketch to finished piece, shown at the term showcase.

kids-art-younger.bring: Nothing; all materials are included. Clothes that can get paint on them.

kids-art-older.headline: Weekly art classes for ages 10 to 15, taught by a working artist.
kids-art-older.intro: Composition, acrylic and watercolour in small groups of up to {cap}, with a portfolio by the end of the year. Good for students who want to get properly better, or who are preparing for art at school.

levels.name: Level 1 · Foundations
levels.text: Observation drawing, tone, perspective and colour theory.

levels.name: Level 2 · Media
levels.text: Acrylic, watercolour and mixed media; studies from life and photographs.

levels.name: Level 3 · Portfolio
levels.text: A self-directed series, critiqued each week and shown at the showcase.

kids-art-older.bring: Nothing; all materials are included. A sketchbook of their own is welcome.

adult-art.headline: A weekly art class for adults: the same teacher, your own project, visible progress.
adult-art.intro: Up to {cap} adults a class. You choose what to work on (drawing, acrylic or watercolour) and carry it week to week with a working artist beside you. Beginners welcome.

levels.name: Start
levels.text: Drawing and colour basics, with short exercises that build confidence quickly.

levels.name: Develop
levels.text: A longer piece in the medium you choose, with one-to-one guidance each week.

levels.name: Finish
levels.text: A finished body of work, and a place at the showcase if you want it.

voice.headline: Voice lessons with Sabrina Hew, recorded so you hear your own progress.
voice.intro: Technique, repertoire and performance in the L2 recording studio. Lessons are recorded, so every few weeks you can hear how far you have come.

levels.name: Foundations
levels.text: Breath, posture, pitch and a healthy, comfortable range.

levels.name: Repertoire
levels.text: Songs chosen with you, in the styles you want to sing.

levels.name: Performance
levels.text: A recorded performance in the studio and a place at the showcase.

voice.bring: Water, and a song you love.

teen-photo-video.headline: A weekly photo and video club for teens: shoot, edit and screen your own work.
teen-photo-video.intro: Up to {cap} teens, every week. They shoot and edit on their phones, post as a club and screen their work once a month. No camera needed.

levels.name: Shoot
levels.text: Light, framing and movement; short exercises on the phone they already have.

levels.name: Edit
levels.text: Cutting, colour and sound in free phone apps.

levels.name: Screen
levels.text: A finished short each month, shown at the club screening.

teen-photo-video.bring: A charged phone with some free storage.

photo-video-adult.headline: Weekly photography and videography for adults and small-business owners.
photo-video-adult.intro: Small groups of up to {cap}. Learn to shoot and edit photos and short videos that look professional, for yourself or for your business.

levels.name: Basics
levels.text: Light, composition and settings on your phone or camera.

levels.name: Projects
levels.text: A product, portrait or short-film project of your choice.

levels.name: Publish
levels.text: Edit, export and post work you are happy to put your name on.

baking-course.headline: A six-week plant-based baking course, from foundations to a bake of your own.
baking-course.intro: Six weekly sessions in the L1 kitchen, up to {cap} bakers. Each week builds on the last, and the final week is a showcase bake you choose yourself.

levels.name: Weeks 1–2 · Foundations
levels.text: Doughs, proving and shaping; the basics every plant-based bake depends on.

levels.name: Weeks 3–4 · Technique
levels.text: Enriched doughs, laminating and plant-based swaps for eggs and butter.

levels.name: Weeks 5–6 · Showcase
levels.text: Plan and bake a showcase piece of your own choice.

baking-course.bring: An apron if you have one; everything else is provided.
